description: This file defines internal interfaces related to asynchronous observables and batch observers within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, including methods for resuming subscriptions, unsubscribing, retrieving subscriptions, and cleanup.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncObservable<T>
classes.description: An internal interface extending async observable functionalities with methods for managing streaming subscriptions and cleanup.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncBatchObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal interface for batch observers, extending batch producer with a cleanup method.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription asynchronously with either an observer or batch observer, optionally from a specific token.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes asynchronously from a given subscription handle.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all current subscription handles asynchronously.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the observable or batch observer.
